name: Christchurch

routes.outcome: Official LINZ NZ Property Boundaries dataset page confirms a national polygon layer, weekly updates, NZGD2000 / EPSG:4167 storage, and public ArcGIS/OGC/API distribution. National agency evidence; not treated as a Christchurch-local custodian.
Official LINZ Landonline Parcel page confirms parcel polygons and stable primary key id, but identifies the full dataset as intended for data professionals. No query was made against this route.
Christchurch City Council public ArcGIS REST Property service loaded and lists LandParcel layer 14. This is local Christchurch service evidence.

LandParcel layer metadata loaded anonymously. Polygon geometry; native layer spatial reference NZTM2000 / EPSG:2193; native identity LandParcelID (OID). Safe source fields observed include LandParcelID, LandPlanNumber, LandParcelNumber, LegalArea, and geometry, but only LandParcelID and geometry were retained.
Exact WUP point query returned zero features. This is recorded as a point-level result only and is not treated as evidence of citywide absence.

Bounded anonymous envelope query returned three Polygon features with native IDs 62389, 63479, and 63627. The unchanged geometry was converted to a retained GeoJSON sample with exactly one canonical property id per feature.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Christchurch City Council ArcGIS REST OpenData/Property/MapServer; layer 14 LandParcel
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Native layer EPSG:2193; sample request requested GeoJSON geometry in EPSG:4326

sourceFieldMapping.geometry: retained unchanged from bounded response, output CRS EPSG:4326

qualification.reason: A real public local parcel service and bounded ID-plus-geometry response were obtained, but source integration/admission remains held pending independent serial review.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
The exact-point zero result is not a citywide absence finding.
The retained sample is limited to three nearby polygons and contains no raw source attribute set.
LINZ is the national cadastral agency; Christchurch City Council is the evidenced local map/API custodian. General national agency prose was not treated as local service evidence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate/title, or personal fields were requested or retained.
The packet is complete as a research record, not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: The local public layer, schema, CRS, stable identity, and bounded geometry response are verified. Coverage semantics, update cadence for the Council layer, and whether the WUP settlement point lies outside mapped land parcels remain uncertain. Runtime/admission remains held.
